mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.userId, f.dishId, f.createdAt, d.dishName, d.description, d.coverImage, d.price FROM favoriteDish f JOIN dish d ON d.id = f.dishId WHERE f.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY f.createdAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO favoriteDish (userId, dishId) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId})
